```{r}
library(nflverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
pbp = load_pbp(2025)
```

```{r}
#drives = pbp |>
#  select(game_id,game_half,game_seconds_remaining,qtr,drive,quarter_seconds_remaining,half_seconds_remaining,quarter_end,drive_time_of_possession,time,play_type_nfl,play,play,play_id,desc,drive_ended_with_score,drive_play_count)

pbp_1 = pbp |>
  filter(play_id != 1,
         season_type=="REG",
         play_type!="extra_point") |>
  group_by(game_id, game_half) |>
  mutate(
    time_elapsed = game_seconds_remaining - lead(game_seconds_remaining),
    time_elapsed = if_else(quarter_end == 1 | time_elapsed < 0, NA_real_, time_elapsed
  )) |>
  ungroup() |>
  #creates summary drive variables
  group_by(game_id, fixed_drive) |>
  mutate(
    drive_top_after_play = cumsum(coalesce(time_elapsed, 0)),
    drive_play_num = cumsum(play_type_nfl %in% c("PASS","RUSH","FIELD_GOAL","SACK")),
    drive_first_downs = sum(first_down,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_rush_attempts = sum(rush_attempt,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_rushing_yards = sum(rushing_yards,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_pass_attempts = sum(pass_attempt,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_pass_yards = sum(passing_yards,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_ends_with_td = factor(
      any(touchdown == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

```

```{r}

#create a table for only plays that end drivs

end_of_drive_plays = pbp_1 |>
  slice_tail(n=1,by=c(game_id,fixed_drive))



```

End of Drive Plays

```{r}
total_drives <- pbp_1 |>
  filter(!is.na(fixed_drive)) |>
  distinct(game_id, fixed_drive) |>
  nrow()

total_drives
```

```{r}

drives_split = group_initial_split(end_of_drive_plays,
                                   group = game_id,
                                   prop = 0.8)
train_data = training(drives_split) 
test_data = testing(drives_split)
#folds = vfold_cv(train_data,v=5)
folds = group_vfold_cv(train_data,group = game_id,v=5)

log_mod <- logistic_reg() |>
  set_engine("glm") |>
  set_mode("classification")

log_recipe <- recipe(drive_ends_with_td ~ drive_first_downs + 
                       drive_rush_attempts +
                       drive_rushing_yards +
                       drive_pass_attempts +
                       drive_pass_yards +
                       drive_top_after_play,
                     data = train_data)

log_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_model(log_mod) |>
  add_recipe(log_recipe)

log_fit <- fit(log_workflow,
               data = train_data)

#Generate class predictions.
class_pred <- predict(log_fit,
                      test_data, type = "class")
test_preds <- predict(log_fit, new_data = test_data, type = "prob") |>
  bind_cols(test_data)

predictions = bind_cols(test_data,class_pred)
results = fit_resamples(
  log_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  metrics = metric_set(
    accuracy,
    recall,
    f_meas)
  )


collect_metrics(results)

conf_mat(
  predictions,
  truth = drive_ends_with_td,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

test_preds |>
  roc_curve(truth = drive_ends_with_td, .pred_TRUE) |>
  autoplot()
```
